lines.zh: 我沿着长廊慢慢走，触角在动。
lines.en: I pace the long hall, antennae twitching.
My green skin takes a sheen under the lamps.

lines.zh: 我赤着脚，地板凉得舒服。
lines.en: I go barefoot; the cool floor feels good.

lines.zh: 拐角处我先探头，再迈步。
lines.en: At corners I look first, then step.

lines.zh: 我抱着几卷图纸，走得稳。
lines.en: Carrying scrolls of plans, I walk steadily.

lines.zh: 脚步很轻，我不想惊动人。
lines.en: My steps are light; I don't want to startle anyone.

lines.zh: 走过天井，我抬头看了看天。
lines.en: Crossing the courtyard, I glance at the sky.
I skirt a basin of water so it won't splash.
The storeroom is at the end of this corridor.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，因为没什么急事。
lines.en: I walk slowly; nothing is urgent.

lines.zh: 我用手扶墙，指尖划过砖缝。
lines.en: I trail a hand on the wall, fingertips through the seams.
Hearing voices, I step to one side.

lines.zh: 我在台阶前停了一下，再上去。
lines.en: I pause at the steps, then climb.
My shadow trails long behind me.
Standing still, my antennae quiver faintly.

lines.zh: 没什么事，我摸了摸耳侧。
lines.en: Nothing to do, so I touch the side of my head.

lines.zh: 我把手拢在袖里，安静等。
lines.en: I fold my hands in my sleeves and wait quietly.

lines.zh: 窗外有鸟，我听了一会儿。
lines.en: Birds outside; I listen for a while.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼，呼吸放得更慢。
lines.en: I close my eyes and slow my breathing further.

lines.zh: 这具身体恢复得比人快。
lines.en: This body mends faster than a human's.
I'm thinking of the wind on Namek.
Standing long, I shift my weight.
I haven't touched the goods list on the table.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我最有耐心。
lines.en: In quiet moments I'm at my most patient.
I touch the pouch at my waist.

lines.zh: 灯芯跳了一下，我没在意。
lines.en: The lamp wick jumps; I pay it no mind.
I'm waiting for someone to settle the books.
My breathing is slow, like a sleeping tree.

lines.zh: 你好，我在这儿做点买卖。
lines.en: Hello. I do a little trade here.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，触角朝你的方向。
lines.en: I look up, antennae turning your way.
No hostility on you. Good.
If you want to see goods, I can bring them out.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打架，先说清楚。
lines.en: I'm no fighter — let me be clear about that.
Where do you come from? Far, I'd guess.

lines.zh: 我侧过头，认真听你说话。
lines.en: I tip my head and listen properly.

lines.zh: 这一带有不少脾气差的人。
lines.en: There are many short-tempered folk around here.

lines.zh: 有事可以问我，我知道一些。
lines.en: Ask if you need; I know a few things.
Dressed like that — an adventurer?

lines.zh: 我微微低头，触角朝你弯了弯。
lines.en: I dip my head a little and let my antennae curl toward you.

lines.zh: 别站太近，我习惯留距离。
lines.en: Not too close; I like some distance.
Your ki is steady; you don't seem wicked.
Take your time; I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你看着我的绿皮肤，我不介意。
lines.en: You stare at my green skin; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 要不要坐下？这儿有凳子。
lines.en: Would you sit? There's a stool.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，我缓得过来。
lines.en: Not too heavy; I'll recover.
I press the wound and back to the wall.
It hurts, but I can bear it.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤颜色深，血不显眼。
lines.en: My skin is dark, so the blood hardly shows.
I grit my teeth; my antennae pull in.

lines.zh: 你别再打了，我不想还手。
lines.en: Stop hitting; I don't want to strike back.

lines.zh: 那美克星商人，差点摔倒。
lines.en: The Namekian merchant nearly fell.
I catch my breath, holding the counter.
The wound will close itself, just slowly.

lines.zh: 我不记恨，但我会记住你。
lines.en: I hold no grudge, but I'll remember you.
This price can be discussed.
I recognize what you're holding.
Let me look closely at the fitting.
This is uncommon; I'd like it.
I reach out, then draw my hand back.
Name a price; I won't haggle much.
Good goods belong with those who know them.
My eyes brighten; I can't hide it.
Just one more look, that's all.
I could put this batch to use.

lines.zh: 那美克星的袍子被撞皱了。
lines.en: My Namekian robe wrinkled.
I step back half a pace and bow slightly.
No harm in a bump; don't mind it.

lines.zh: 这儿路窄，我们先让一让。
lines.en: The way's narrow; let's both make room.

lines.zh: 我扶住差点倒下的架子。
lines.en: I catch the shelf before it topples.
Your arm is hard as iron.

lines.zh: 我往后靠，给你留出空间。
lines.en: I lean back to give you space.

lines.zh: 撞歪了我的布袋，我系紧。
lines.en: You knocked my pouch loose; I retie it.
No rush; the hall is long.
This frame of mine doesn't take shoving well.

lines.zh: 我们那美克星人，不常谈这个。
lines.en: We Namekians seldom speak of such things.

lines.zh: 先做朋友，别的事慢慢来。
lines.en: Friends first; the rest can wait.

lines.zh: 我这样的人，活得比你想的长。
lines.en: My kind live longer than you'd think.

lines.zh: 你若愿意留下，我不会赶你。
lines.en: If you choose to stay, I won't send you off.

lines.zh: 两颗心稳下来，才靠得近。
lines.en: Two steady hearts may come close.
I speak slowly; don't mind it.
This place is too loud for that.
Your ki sits well with mine.
I've brewed tea. Sit.
I make no promises, but I'll be here.
A corner of this scroll tore off.
I pick it up and shake off the dust.
Whose is this? Still quite new.

lines.zh: 我把它放回该在的柜子。
lines.en: I put it back in the cabinet it belongs in.

lines.zh: 捡东西的时候，我弯得很慢。
lines.en: When I pick things up, I bend slowly.
This metal scrap has some weight.

lines.zh: 地上的东西不捡，会被踩坏。
lines.en: Left on the floor, it gets crushed.

lines.zh: 我用布包好才收进袋里。
lines.en: I wrap it in cloth before putting it away.
Just short of this — lucky.

lines.zh: 那美克星的货，只换不送。
lines.en: Namekian goods are trade only, never gifts.

lines.zh: 你的气变了，我察觉得到。
lines.en: Your ki has changed; I feel it.
I set down what I'm holding.

lines.zh: 我退到柜台后面，慢慢来。
lines.en: I move behind the counter, slowly.
You're not here to buy.
I watch your hands and say nothing.

lines.zh: 这一带常有强盗，我明白。
lines.en: Bandits are common here. I understand.

lines.zh: 我把贵重的东西挡在身后。
lines.en: I put the valuables behind me.
If you strike, I'll evade.
I don't want to hurt anyone, but I'll run.

lines.zh: 你的脚步靠近柜台，我听见了。
lines.en: Your footsteps near the counter; I hear them.
I turn sideways, toes pointing at the door.

lines.zh: 你每靠近一步，我就退一步。
lines.en: Every step you take, I take one back.
I know this room better than you.

lines.zh: 我数着你的呼吸，等机会。
lines.en: I count your breaths, waiting for a chance.

lines.zh: 你挡住光了，我往旁边挪。
lines.en: You're blocking the light; I shift aside.

lines.zh: 我背贴着墙，不让你绕后。
lines.en: My back to the wall, so you can't circle.

lines.zh: 别把门关了，那对谁都不好。
lines.en: Don't close the door; that helps no one.
I raise a hand slowly, palm toward you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往门口挪，不敢转身。
lines.en: I edge slowly toward the door, not daring to turn.

lines.zh: 我脚边有条退路，你没堵住。
lines.en: There's a way out at my feet; you haven't blocked it.
I raise my arm to block; it goes numb.
I shove you and use the push to retreat.
This palm strike is only to break free.
I kick a stool in front of your feet.
I can't fight, but I can block.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕往下压。
lines.en: I catch your wrist and press it down.
You step back, and I use it to withdraw.
I guard my face; hit me elsewhere if you must.

lines.zh: 我抄起算盘砸过去，手在抖。
lines.en: I swing the abacus at you, my hands shaking.
Don't make me strike; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我被安置在这间铺子里。
lines.en: I've been placed in this shop.
The door opens and I light the lamp.

lines.zh: 我是从很远的星球来的。
lines.en: I came from a very distant world.

lines.zh: 这具身子在陌生的地方站定。
lines.en: This body settles on unfamiliar ground.
First I set the goods in order.
The room smells of new brick.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸墙，确定这是实的。
lines.en: I touch the wall to be sure it's solid.
The sky here is bluer than home.
I sit and wait for the first customer.
The lamp is lit, so we're open.
Fire tightens my skin.

lines.zh: 我从高处跌下，骨头在响。
lines.en: I fall from a height and hear my bones.

lines.zh: 水灌进口鼻，我说不出话。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and nose; I can't speak.
Blast ash covers my whole face.

lines.zh: 一支箭射穿了我的袖子。
lines.en: An arrow tears through my sleeve.

lines.zh: 这咒力让我的伤合不上。
lines.en: This curse keeps my wound from closing.

lines.zh: 只喝水不进食，撑不了多久。
lines.en: Water alone won't sustain me long.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的触角窜下来。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my antennae.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有声音，只有下落。
lines.en: No sound in the void, only falling.
